request.style: English, male baritone solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle drums, warm and hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Three months at sea on Alexandrian ship
At Syracuse we stayed three days
To Rhegium we went and Puteoli too
Brothers invited us to stay a week

[Verse]
We came to Rome and met the elders
Paul said I did no wrong to my people
They wanted to release me from my chains
But I appealed to Caesar for hope

[Chorus]
Proclaiming the kingdom of God
Teaching about the Lord Jesus Christ
With complete boldness and full assurance
Without any hindrance at all

[Verse]
From morning until evening he spoke
Testifying about Jesus from the Law
Some were convinced by his words
Others would not believe his message

[Chorus]
Proclaiming the kingdom of God
Teaching about the Lord Jesus Christ
With complete boldness and full assurance
Without any hindrance at all
